scenes.title: He failed twice. Then $1 million.
scenes.say: He failed twice. Then he sold for a million dollars.

scenes.label: His Philadelphia candy shop. It failed, then New York did too.
scenes.say: His Philadelphia candy shop, opened in eighteen seventy six, failed. So did New York.

scenes.label: 1900: he sold his Lancaster Caramel Company
scenes.say: Then his Lancaster caramels took off. In nineteen hundred, he sold that company for a million dollars.

scenes.title: Then came chocolate.
scenes.say: Then came chocolate. Follow for more founder stories.
